clues.text: Paul's group went to this Roman colony, the leading city of its district of Macedonia, and stayed several days.
In this Macedonian city, an aggravated Paul commanded a spirit in Jesus' name to come out of a girl.
In this Macedonian city, a dealer in purple cloth from Thyatira listened as the Lord opened her heart.
In this Macedonian city, a jailer brought Paul and Silas out and asked what he must do to be saved.
In this Macedonian city, a strong earthquake shook the prison, flinging open its doors and loosening everyone's chains.
Paul and Timothy wrote to the saints in this Macedonian city, along with its overseers and deacons.
Paul told the Thessalonians he had suffered shameful treatment in this city before preaching to them.
